book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Kx Ayrnrngr Mz Lr Tesalonika

content: Naoliqti-zvzku Nzyzlu-krm Kxetu
Mzlegrng, mzli ka trnayrpwzkru bamu mz mzli kc na-adcpx-lzbq-ngrm Kxetu rgu o zbq kc nayzlu-ngrmle.
Murde krlzpeamu kx mzli lc nakctipx, na-apule ncblo kc tqpna da mz nrlckxbq.

Leplz kx trnzrlxngitiung narpilr kx, “Nigr ka tqmnc-zpwxpekr ye mz nrwx.” A' mzli lcde, nzayrplapxngr nidr sa na-ani txpwz, na-apule nimz ngr zvetqkr nibr olvz kx narmika. X sa narblxbz mz leplz lcng nzrlapx-krdr mz nzlva-krdr.
A' trnakctipxwamuu nzvz-krm Mzli lc Tqmatq, mz nzapu-krde nzvz-krm ncblo kc tqpna da. Murde trvz-nqblqpewamuu nqmq ngr alwx.
A' nimu doa neng Kraes kcng tqvz-nqblqamu nzalvztrngr angidrng x aleamu da kxtubq. A' tralepekuu da kx amyale drtq kcng tqyc-kapq.

Bzkq apuku kxtrnzrlxngitiung. Murde alwx ngrdrng nzakamrbr-ngrdr da mz nabzdr x nzapulr leplz kx nzmwing, murde trnzkrlzlru drtwr ngr da kx prtilzmqng mzli ka mz nrlc. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, na-aclvetio-lzbqku x nalolvzo-lzbqku.
Murde nrlckxbq mzli r alwx, mzli r nzmwingr, x mzli r nzrmnqngr.

Mz nzvz-nqblq-krgu nzalvztrngr angidr, na-aclvetio-lzbqku. Na-apuku ncblo ngr vea mz nzvec-krgu badr Setzn. Nzrlxngiti-krgu x nivz lrgu na-ayrbqpxle nabzgu na-apule temz ngr lomrgu kc tqyrputrngr nipna. X nzarlapxkr Kraes nigu na-ayrbqpxle drtwrgu na-apule da kxmqngi kx nalalvzle nar ncblo ngr vea, murde mz drtwrgu kxbr, obqtipxku da amrlx kx vzpxm mz nzarlapx-krde nigu.
X nadcpx mz drtwrgu kx Gct mcpxle nigu x arlapxpele nigu mz nzbzkr Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. A' trmcpxleu nigu mz nzayrplapx-alo-krde nigu.
Kxmule-esz' bzpeku o lubeku mzli kc nayzlu-ngrm Jiszs, a' bz-ngrde murde nalu-zvzku badr.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, apqtramu drtwrmu x axplr-lzbqamu da kc tqwaiamu mzli ka.
Natq Ngr Nzarlr-lzbqngr
Mzli ka, mzlegrng x inwegrng, na-amatqamu krkcng tzwz-katong mz mzlirmu, mz nzaclve-krdr nimu mz zmatq ngr Kxetu x mz nzalvztr-krdr nimu.
Mz nivz angidr, aelwa-ngrbzmu badr kx amatqamu nidr mz nzwzngr kcng tzalebzlr bamu. X mnc-zpwx-lxblramu.
Mzlegrng x inwegrng, lalztqmamu bagr. Axplrbzmu natqmu mz krkcng drtqdr tqsa. Apqtrpzmu drtwr krkcng tzmwxlrng. Okatramu krkcng nabzdr tqbao mz nzlxngiti-krdr. X mnc-zpwxamu badr leplz amrlx.
Aclvetio-lzbqamu x bzkq ayzlubzmu da kxtrka mz da kxtrka. A' na-alebzmu da kxmrlz mz kztemung x leplz amrlx.
Naelalz-zvz-ngrm drtwrmu!
Nakrka'-zvzamu!
Kxmule-esz' nike prtz, a' na-awi-zvz-ngrbzmu mz Gct da lc. Murde suti drtwrde kx doa amrlx kcng tzlxngitilr Jiszs na-awi-zvzbzng bade.
Bzkq rpwa'-ngrnamu nzwzkr Mqngrkxtr.
Bzkq apusr-ngrnamu natq x nrpa kc tqaelwapx-ngrbz Mqngrkxtr mz leplz brmrda.
A' mzli kc tqrpingr kzdq ncblo kx natqde aelwa-ngrbz Mqngrkxtr, naobqtitr-kaiamu da amrlx. X yrlq-zvzamu natq kxmrlz.
A' yrlqpx-lzbqamu mz natq kxtrka amrlx.

Nzkrka'-krgr nimu nide sele: “Gct, nim kc tqrkam bagr nzmnc-zpwxngr. Krka'-ngrgr kx na-atrq nidr mz da amrlx. Murde nztubq-krdr mz mqngrdr, nabzdr, x nrkrdrtqdr navz nakrlzbzle nzyzlu-krm Kxetu rgr Jiszs Kxnzmcpx.
Nim kc tqkqlepele nidr. X lxngitikr kx sa na-atutrq natqmqng amrlx. Eu. Angida!”
Mzlegrng x inwegrng, nakrka'-kz-ngrnamu nigr.
Pibz “Nimu la,” mz inwegung x mzlegung amrlx mrla, mz nzmale-lxblr-krmu mqmu mz nivz.
Rngidrtx-zlwz-ngrbo bamu mz zmatq ngr Kxetu, kx natqgr lcng narlwxbz mz leplz neng Kraes amrlx.
Krka'-ngrgr kx Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx naokatrle nimu mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz. Delape. Ninge Pol, nigr ncdr Saelas x Timoti.
